_comment: Pinned third-party components for StremioZ. Bump these together with the AnimeJaNai release they came from (see the-database/mpv-AnimeJaNai BuildMpvUpscale2xAnimeJaNai/Program.cs).

streamingServer._note: Stremio's own server.js. Re-uploaded by Stremio on 2025-12-22, so the checksum in version/version-details.json (Community's) no longer matches.

kai._note: Vendored in vendor/kai/portable_config (StremioZ edits marked 'StremioZ'). Scripts/webmods from the repo commit; shaders and fonts from the release archive.

webui._note: Zaarrg's Stremio Web build (stremio.zarg.me), built from source by tools/build-webui.ps1; Kai's theme targets its class names
